'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Jacksonville shooting]]
**Three people are killed in a racially motivated shooting at a store in [[Jacksonville]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator, who [[suicide in the United States|killed himself]] [[Murder–suicide|after the attack]], released a [[manifesto]] against [[black people]]. [https://apnews.com/article/florida-store-shooting-fatalities-b65ecad5f81ac8aa35121507dd4f7dcc (AP)]
*[[2023 Nigerien crisis]]
**The ruling [[Niger]]ien [[National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland|military government]] orders the [[Niger Armed Forces]] to go on maximum alert, citing an increased threat of attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/26/niger-puts-military-on-maximum-alert-over-attack-fears-by-ecowas (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**Seven people are killed when gang members open fire on a protest in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-66631188 (BBC News)]
*Aftermath of the [[Tigray War]]
**Four people are killed and twenty are injured in a [[grenade]] attack by a former [[TPLF]] combatant in [[Mekelle]], [[Tigray Region|Tigray]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://borkena.com/2023/08/26/tigray-four-reportedly-killed-in-grenade-attack/ (Borkena)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
****The [[governor]] of [[Belgorod Oblast]] says that [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] and usage of [[cluster munitions]] injured six [[civilian]]s in [[Urazovo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/8/26/russia-ukraine-war-live-ukrainian-commander-hails-breakthrough-in-south (Al Jazeera)] 
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell the front-line city of [[Kupiansk]], killing two people and injuring another. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/shelling-kills-civilians-in-ukraine-s-northeast-as-fears-grow-of-a-second-russian-takeover/ar-AA1fNSAu?OCID=ansmsnnews11 (AP via MSN)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[British Museum]] chair [[George Osborne]] announces that the museum has begun the process of recovering [[British Museum#Thefts|2,000 stolen artifacts]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/culture/2023/aug/26/recovery-british-museum-artefacts-under-way-george-osborne (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Ukraine]]’s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|foreign ministry]] expresses opposition to a continuation of [[European Union]] [[import restrictions]] on its [[grain]] after member states including [[Poland]], [[Slovakia]], [[Bulgaria]], [[Romania]], and [[Hungary]] supported an extension. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/8/26/russia-ukraine-war-live-ukrainian-commander-hails-breakthrough-in-south (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Panama Canal]] imposes a one-year restriction on [[Sea lane|ship passage]] due to severe drought conditions, leading to delays and decreased maritime traffic. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/08/26/23/drought-hit-panama-canal-to-restrict-access-for-one-year (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**A new brush fire in [[Maui]], [[United States]], burns up to 10 [[acre]]s in a [[Kaanapali, Hawaii|Kaanapali]] neighborhood located a few miles from the [[Lahaina, Hawaii|Lahaina]] area damaged by [[wildfire]]s, prompting [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]]. The evacuation order is lifted after the fire was contained. [https://apnews.com/article/hawaii-lahaina-brush-fire-evacuation-57be4651b14e0becb885226ef2cbb8de (AP)] [https://www.staradvertiser.com/2023/08/26/breaking-news/maui-issues-evacuation-order-for-some-kaanapali-residents-due-to-wildfire/amp/ (''Honolulu Star-Advertiser'')]
*Nine people are killed and nine more are injured when a [[Gas cylinder|gas canister]] explodes on a train in [[Madurai]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-66629410 (BBC News)]
*Three people were killed and 46 others were injured in series of [[explosion]]s at a [[Liquefied petroleum gas|liquefied petroleum gas]] station in [[Crevedia]], [[Romania]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2023/0826/1401865-at-least-one-dead-46-hurt-after-explosions-in-romania/ (Reuters via RTÉ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*American [[food delivery]] platform [[DoorDash]] announces that it will pay $1.6 million to its workers after a [[Seattle]] Office of Labor Standards investigation finds that the company failed to implement the city’s required [[Sick leave in the United States|sick and safe time policy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/doordash-seattle-sick-time-policy-violation-settlement-b8fd725e9b50631c40e041b418112ae0 (AP)]
*[[2023 Greece wildfires]]
**Fire department officials in [[Greece]] arrest two men on suspicion of [[arson|setting fires]] amid ongoing wildfires. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-wildfires-arson-71a563e6717ff308cd2e68ccd7274ead (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Gabonese general election]]
**[[Gabon]]ese citizens vote for a [[President of Gabon|president]] and members of the [[National Assembly of Gabon|parliament]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230826-gabon-s-bongo-seeks-third-term-in-nationwide-poll (AFP via France 24)]
**The [[Government of Gabon|government]] imposes a nightly [[curfew]] and suspends [[Internet in Gabon|internet access]] following the closure of polls, citing the need to prevent violence and [[misinformation]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/08/26/curfew-imposed-internet-cut-as-polls-close-in-gabon_6109936_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[2023 Zimbabwean general election]]
**[[President of Zimbabwe|President]] [[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] is re-elected to a second term with 52.6% of the vote, defeating main challenger [[Nelson Chamisa]] who garners 44%. Mnangagwa's [[ZANU–PF]] also wins a majority in the [[National Assembly of Zimbabwe|National Assembly]] elections. Chamisa's [[Citizens Coalition for Change]] rejects the results, alleging [[Electoral fraud|electoral irregularities]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/3232434/zimbabwes-president-mnangagwa-wins-second-term-electoral-commission-confirms (AFP via ''SCMP'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Disputes involving the Spain women's national football team]]
**[[FIFA]] suspends [[Royal Spanish Football Federation|Spanish football federation]] president [[Luis Rubiales]] for 90 days for kissing [[Spain women's national football team|player]] [[Jennifer Hermoso]] after the [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup final]]. Hermoso says that Rubiales acted [[Sexual assault|without her consent]], which Rubiales denies. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230826-spanish-federation-threatens-legal-action-over-hermoso-lies (AFP via France 24)]
*American [[triathlete]] [[Taylor Knibb]] wins her second consecutive [[Ironman 70.3|Ironman 70.3 World Championship]] title with a time of 3:53:02, five seconds ahead of runner-up [[Kat Matthews]]. [https://www.tri247.com/triathlon-news/elite/ironman-70-3-world-championship-2023-results-women (Tri247)]
